ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: kaɲoʃa ikaba jahoze aɾi imwe mu ma komine aɡize intaɾa ja bud͡ʒumbuɾa maiɾie aɾiko mu ɲuma vʲaɡije ɡuhinduka muɡihe habajeho uɡuhinduɾa amakomine mu ntaɾaja bud͡ʒumbuɾa maiɾie ikaba jat͡ʃije iɡiɾa ikomine zitatu zikaba aɾi muha , ntahaŋwa na mukaza . hamaze kubaho iɾʲo hinduka ɾʲa makomine kaɲoʃa ikaba jat͡ʃije ihinduka ikaba umutumba zone wo muɾi komine muha .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Niyo mpamvu ukwo ubumara buba bwinshi niko hashika igihe igitigu cononekara hagaca habaho indwara y'igitigu.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: nijo mpamvu ukwo ubumaɾa buba bwinʃi niko haʃika iɡihe iɡitiɡu t͡ʃononekaɾa haɡat͡ʃa habaho indwaɾa j iɡitiɡu .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: N'ayo akazina "Dudu" bakamwise ari muto kubera ibintu vyose yavyita "Dudu" baca barakamutazira gushika na bugingo n'ubu. Yatanguye kuririmba afise imyaka icumi n'itanu (15). Yahereye kuri "Centre Jeune Kamenge", yari mu runganwe rumwe na ba Kaka Boney".
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: n ajo akazina dudu bakamwise aɾi muto kubeɾa ibintu vʲose javʲita dudu bat͡ʃa baɾakamutaziɾa ɡuʃika na buɡiŋo n ubu . jataŋuje kuɾiɾimba afise imʲaka it͡ʃumi n itanu it͡ʃumi na ɡatanu . jaheɾeje kuɾi t͡ʃentɾe d͡ʒeune kameŋe , jaɾi mu ɾuŋanwe ɾumwe na ba kaka bonej .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Kenya ni igihugu kimwe mubihugu biri kumugabane wa Afrika kikaba no Muri Afrika y'ubuseruko, ndetse kikaba kiri no mubihugu bigize umuryango wa Afrika y'ubuseruko.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: keɲa ni iɡihuɡu kimwe mubihuɡu biɾi kumuɡabane wa afɾika kikaba no muɾi afɾika j ubuseɾuko , ndetse kikaba kiɾi no mubihuɡu biɡize umuɾʲaŋo wa afɾika j ubuseɾuko .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Ni Ijambo ry'ikirundi rikoreshwa mu Burundi irisigura igihimba c'umubiri w'umukobwa kiri musi y'ibitugu.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: ni id͡ʒambo ɾʲ ikiɾundi ɾikoɾeʃwa mu buɾundi iɾisiɡuɾa iɡihimba t͡ʃ umubiɾi w umukobwa kiɾi musi j ibituɡu .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Igikoresho bakoresha mu kurima (ibiharage,ibigori,ibiraya ,iibitoke)
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: iɡikoɾeʃo bakoɾeʃa mu kuɾima ibihaɾaɡe , ibiɡoɾi , ibiɾaja , iːbitoke

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Ibikorwa vy’igihanga ni ugukingira ubwonko, gutanga umwanya ku maso no ku matwi kugira ngo umuntu abone neza kandi amenye aho amajwi ava. Ku bikoko bifise amahembe, igihanga gikingira mu gutanga ahashingira amahembe.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: ibikoɾwa vʲ iɡihaŋa ni uɡukiŋiɾa ubwonko , ɡutaŋa umwaɲa ku maso no ku matwi kuɡiɾa ŋo umuntu abone neza kandi ameɲe aho amad͡ʒwi ava . ku bikoko bifise amahembe , iɡihaŋa ɡikiŋiɾa mu ɡutaŋa ahaʃiŋiɾa amahembe .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Mu mpera z'imyaka ya 90, amaze gusohora umuziki wiwe wa mbere mu mugwi Nigga soul, Mugani Désiré yaciye afata ingingo yo gutangura umuziki wiwe wenyene. Yavumbuwe na Kidum Kibido, umuhinga mu vy’ubuhinga bw’amasanamu w’Umurundi aba muri Kenya, amuha amasezerano yo gukora iyo filime.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: mu mpeɾa z imʲaka ja miɾoŋo it͡ʃenda , amaze ɡusohoɾa umuziki wiwe wa mbeɾe mu muɡwi niɡɡa soul , muɡani desiɾe jat͡ʃije afata iŋiŋo jo ɡutaŋuɾa umuziki wiwe weɲene . javumbuwe na kidum kibido , umuhiŋa mu vʲ ubuhiŋa bw amasanamu w umuɾundi aba muɾi keɲa , amuha amasezeɾano jo ɡukoɾa ijo filime .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: uruzi mugere ruherereye mubumanuko bwigisagara ca Bujumbura. ariko rukaba rukomoka muri komine ya mukike musi yumusozi wa heha biherereye muntara ya Bujumbura bankunze kwita (bujumbura rural)
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: uɾuzi muɡeɾe ɾuheɾeɾeje mubumanuko bwiɡisaɡaɾa t͡ʃa bud͡ʒumbuɾa . aɾiko ɾukaba ɾukomoka muɾi komine ja mukike musi jumusozi wa heha biheɾeɾeje muntaɾa ja bud͡ʒumbuɾa bankunze kwita bud͡ʒumbuɾa ɾuɾal

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Yasohoye indirimbo nyinshi zirimwo umudiho wa RnB.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: jasohoje indiɾimbo ɲinʃi ziɾimwo umudiho wa ɾnb .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Dushimirimana Bénie ni umukenguzamateka akomoka mu gihugu c'Uburundi akava mu ntara ya Kayanza avuka mu 1980.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: duʃimiɾimana benie ni umukeŋuzamateka akomoka mu ɡihuɡu t͡ʃ ubuɾundi akava mu ntaɾa ja kajanza avuka mu iɡihumbi na amad͡ʒana t͡ʃenda na miɾoŋo inani .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Inyuma y'amatora yo 2018 y'ibwirizwa nshingiro haragiyeho intara nshasha hisunzwe indinganizo nshasha ifatiye kuberere no kwiterambere ryabwo icogihe inama shingamateka yaratoye yongera iremeza ko intara 5 arizo zigiye kurangwa mugihugu cose
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: iɲuma j amatoɾa jo ibihumbi bibiɾi na it͡ʃumi na umunani j ibwiɾizwa nʃiŋiɾo haɾaɡijeho intaɾa nʃaʃa hisunzwe indiŋanizo nʃaʃa ifatije kubeɾeɾe no kwiteɾambeɾe ɾʲabwo it͡ʃoɡihe inama ʃiŋamateka jaɾatoje joŋeɾa iɾemeza ko intaɾa ɡatanu aɾizo ziɡije kuɾaŋwa muɡihuɡu t͡ʃose

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: umunyafrika atari Umunya-Uganda agiye kuruwo mwanya kuva mushigwa ry’iyo misiyo mu 2007.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: umuɲafɾika ataɾi umuɲa uɡanda aɡije kuɾuwo mwaɲa kuva muʃiɡwa ɾʲ ijo misijo mu ibihumbi bibiɾi na indwi .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: - Amazi menshi: Umuceri umera neza mu mazi (akenshi utera mu buryo bwitwa "paddy fields").
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: amazi menʃi , umut͡ʃeɾi umeɾa neza mu mazi akenʃi uteɾa mu buɾʲo bwitwa paddʲ fields .

ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: nkakaɾoɾeɾo , waɾuzi ko uʃoboɾa kumaɾa umusi wose utibɾoʃed͡ʒe aɾiko mukanwa ukaɡuma uhema akamoto keza ?

ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: biʃoboɾa koŋeɾwamo amabuje kuɡiɾa ŋo habe beton jo ɡusakaɾa t͡ʃaŋwa ɡukoɾa fondasijo .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Mumvugo zicisha make ( imvugo mbabariramatwi): Hari amazina y’uruhindu nka "igituba c’umugabo" canke bakavuga "igihimba c'irondoka c'umugabo"
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: mumvuɡo zit͡ʃiʃa make imvuɡo mbabaɾiɾamatwi , haɾi amazina j uɾuhindu nka iɡituba t͡ʃ umuɡabo t͡ʃanke bakavuɡa iɡihimba t͡ʃ iɾondoka t͡ʃ umuɡabo

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Inkuru ya Livingstone na Stanley mu Burundi ni inkuru y'ubutwari yaranzwe n'ubushakashatsi irimwo uruja n'uruza rw'amateka. Ni imwe muzamenyekanye cane mu mateka y'ubushakashatsi bwa Afurika ,ikagira uruhara mu nzira z'ivugabutumwa, ubucuruzi,n'ukwigarurira ibihugu( colonisation).
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: inkuɾu ja liviŋstone na stanlej mu buɾundi ni inkuɾu j ubutwaɾi jaɾanzwe n ubuʃakaʃatsi iɾimwo uɾud͡ʒa n uɾuza ɾw amateka . ni imwe muzameɲekaɲe t͡ʃane mu mateka j ubuʃakaʃatsi bwa afuɾika , ikaɡiɾa uɾuhaɾa mu nziɾa z ivuɡabutumwa , ubut͡ʃuɾuzi , n ukwiɡaɾuɾiɾa ibihuɡu t͡ʃolonisation .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Ku ruhande rw’Uburundi, Ikiyaga Tanganyika gikora ku ntara za Bujumbura Mairie, Bujumbura Rural na Rumonge, aho kibera isoko ikomeye y’ubuzima ku banyagihugu.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: ku ɾuhande ɾw ubuɾundi , ikijaɡa taŋaɲika ɡikoɾa ku ntaɾa za bud͡ʒumbuɾa maiɾie , bud͡ʒumbuɾa ɾuɾal na ɾumoŋe , aho kibeɾa isoko ikomeje j ubuzima ku baɲaɡihuɡu .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Mu nyuma, amazi yarwo yisuka mu rundi ruzi runini bita Mucece, aho amazi yarwo akomeza urugendo rwerekeza mu yindi migezi minini y’igihugu.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: mu ɲuma , amazi jaɾwo jisuka mu ɾundi ɾuzi ɾunini bita mut͡ʃet͡ʃe , aho amazi jaɾwo akomeza uɾuɡendo ɾweɾekeza mu jindi miɡezi minini j iɡihuɡu .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Gukingira amazi si itegeko ry’amahinguriro gusa, ahubwo ni iya bose: leta, abikorera, n’abanyagihugu. Muri kazoza hasukuye haterwa n’ingingo dufata uyu musi.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: ɡukiŋiɾa amazi si iteɡeko ɾʲ amahiŋuɾiɾo ɡusa , ahubwo ni ija bose , leta , abikoɾeɾa , n abaɲaɡihuɡu . muɾi kazoza hasukuje hateɾwa n iŋiŋo dufata uju musi .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Mu gihe c’ubu, hari n’imashini zo kumesura (washing machines) zifasha abantu gukora iki gikorwa mu buryo bworoshe kandi bwihuta.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: mu ɡihe t͡ʃ ubu , haɾi n imaʃini zo kumesuɾa waʃiŋ mat͡ʃhines zifaʃa abantu ɡukoɾa iki ɡikoɾwa mu buɾʲo bwoɾoʃe kandi bwihuta .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Uruzi ruva mu rusobe rw’iyindi migezi mito mito n’amazi n’ibishanga, rugahurira hamwe n’ayandi mazi y’akarere ka Niger Delta.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: uɾuzi ɾuva mu ɾusobe ɾw ijindi miɡezi mito mito n amazi n ibiʃaŋa , ɾuɡahuɾiɾa hamwe n ajandi mazi j akaɾeɾe ka niɡeɾ delta .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Amazi ya Ruvubu afasha mu bikorwa vy'uburimyi, cane cane mu bibaya biri hafi y'uru ruzi. Abanyagihugu bakoresha ayo mazi mu kuvomera imirima no mu bindi bikorwa vy'ubuhinzi.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: amazi ja ɾuvubu afaʃa mu bikoɾwa vʲ ubuɾimʲi , t͡ʃane t͡ʃane mu bibaja biɾi hafi j uɾu ɾuzi . abaɲaɡihuɡu bakoɾeʃa ajo mazi mu kuvomeɾa imiɾima no mu bindi bikoɾwa vʲ ubuhinzi .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Uruzi rwa Nil rufise imiterere igoye kuko ruturuka mu turere dufise ikirere gitandukanye. Hari ibice bifise imvura nyinshi (nk’u Rwanda, Burundi, Ethiopia), n’ibice bifise ubutayu (nk’Misiri).
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: uɾuzi ɾwa nil ɾufise imiteɾeɾe iɡoje kuko ɾutuɾuka mu tuɾeɾe dufise ikiɾeɾe ɡitandukaɲe . haɾi ibit͡ʃe bifise imvuɾa ɲinʃi nk u ɾwanda , buɾundi , ethiopia , n ibit͡ʃe bifise ubutaju nk misiɾi .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Izina « Ruvubu » rikomoka ku ijambo ry'Ikirundi « imvubu », kubera ko uru ruzi rwahora rubamwo imvubu nyinshi .
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: izina ɾuvubu ɾikomoka ku id͡ʒambo ɾʲ ikiɾundi imvubu , kubeɾa ko uɾu ɾuzi ɾwahoɾa ɾubamwo imvubu ɲinʃi .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Uruzi rwa Mucece rufise akamaro kanini mw'iterambere ry'abanyagihugu bo muri Komine Kiganda. Amazi yarwo akoreshwa mu kuvomera imirima, cane cane iy'imboga, ibigori, ibiharage, imyumbati n'ibindi vyimburwa birimwa kuri uryo ruzi.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: uɾuzi ɾwa mut͡ʃet͡ʃe ɾufise akamaɾo kanini mw iteɾambeɾe ɾʲ abaɲaɡihuɡu bo muɾi komine kiɡanda . amazi jaɾwo akoɾeʃwa mu kuvomeɾa imiɾima , t͡ʃane t͡ʃane ij imboɡa , ibiɡoɾi , ibihaɾaɡe , imʲumbati n ibindi vʲimbuɾwa biɾimwa kuɾi uɾʲo ɾuzi .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Uruzi rwa Muha (mu gifaransa: rivière Muha) ni uruzi rwo mu gihugu c'Uburundi, ruca mu bumanuko bw'igisagara ca Bujumbura. Rufise ibibazo vyinshi vy'imyuzure n'isuri, bikongerezwa no gucukurwa kw'umusenyi n'amabuye mu ruzi kugira bikoreshwe mu kwubaka.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: uɾuzi ɾwa muha mu ɡifaɾansa , ɾivieɾe muha ni uɾuzi ɾwo mu ɡihuɡu t͡ʃ ubuɾundi , ɾut͡ʃa mu bumanuko bw iɡisaɡaɾa t͡ʃa bud͡ʒumbuɾa . ɾufise ibibazo vʲinʃi vʲ imʲuzuɾe n isuɾi , bikoŋeɾezwa no ɡut͡ʃukuɾwa kw umuseɲi n amabuje mu ɾuzi kuɡiɾa bikoɾeʃwe mu kwubaka .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Muri ico gihe, amazi meza yari make cane mu mitumba myinshi. Ivyo vyatumye amasoko kavukire nk'iri vomo aba itunga ridasanzwe ku banyagihugu. Hari imiryango yavoma amazi menshi ku munsi kugira ishobore kurangura ibikorwa vyayo vya misi vyose.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: muɾi it͡ʃo ɡihe , amazi meza jaɾi make t͡ʃane mu mitumba mʲinʃi . ivʲo vʲatumʲe amasoko kavukiɾe nk iɾi vomo aba ituŋa ɾidasanzwe ku baɲaɡihuɡu . haɾi imiɾʲaŋo javoma amazi menʃi ku munsi kuɡiɾa iʃoboɾe kuɾaŋuɾa ibikoɾwa vʲajo vʲa misi vʲose .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Mu gihe c’imvura, ibikoko vyinshi birahurira ku nkengera z’uruzi kugira ngo bibone amazi n’ibifungurwa. Ivyo bituma Buffels riba ahantu h’ingenzi mu guhuza ibinyabuzima.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: mu ɡihe t͡ʃ imvuɾa , ibikoko vʲinʃi biɾahuɾiɾa ku nkeŋeɾa z uɾuzi kuɡiɾa ŋo bibone amazi n ibifuŋuɾwa . ivʲo bituma buffels ɾiba ahantu h iŋenzi mu ɡuhuza ibiɲabuzima .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Aka karere karangwa kandi n’ubushuhe bwinshi ku murango hamwe n’ubukonje bwiyongera mw’ijoro, ikintu gisanzwe kiboneka mu turere tw’ubutayu.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: aka kaɾeɾe kaɾaŋwa kandi n ubuʃuhe bwinʃi ku muɾaŋo hamwe n ubukond͡ʒe bwijoŋeɾa mw id͡ʒoɾo , ikintu ɡisanzwe kiboneka mu tuɾeɾe tw ubutaju .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Uruzi rwa Ruvyironza ni uruzi ruto ruri mu gihugu c’Uburundi ariko rufise agaciro kanini cane ku rwego mpuzamakungu. ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: uɾuzi ɾwa kabujeŋe ni ɾumwe mu miɡezi mito ivuɡwa mu bit͡ʃe bitandukaɲe vʲ iɡihuɡu t͡ʃa buɾundi . naho ata makuɾu menʃi janditse ku ɾweɡo mpuzamakuŋu aboneka ku buɾʲo buɾambuje , izina kabujeŋe ɾikunze ɡukoɾeʃwa mu mvuɡo j abaɲaɡihuɡu mu kweɾekana imiɡezi mito , amasoko j amazi , t͡ʃanke imiɡende j amazi iɡiɾa uɾuhaɾa ɾunini mu buzima bwa misi jose .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Uruzi rwa Magara ruherereye mu buraruko canke hagati mu gihugu c’Uburundi (bitewe n’akarere kavugwa na bamwe mu baturage), mu micungararo y’imisozi mito n’ibibaya bifise ubutaka burimwo ivyatsi n’amashyamba mato.

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Uruzi rwa Gikoma ni uruzi ruto ugereranije n’izindi nzuzi nini zo mu Bujumbura, ariko rufise akamaro gakomeye cane mu buhinzi, ibidukikije, n’ubuzima bw’abanyagihugu. ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: uɾuzi ɾwa ɡikoma ni uɾuzi ɾuto uɡeɾeɾanid͡ʒe n izindi nzuzi nini zo mu bud͡ʒumbuɾa , aɾiko ɾufise akamaɾo ɡakomeje t͡ʃane mu buhinzi , ibidukikid͡ʒe , n ubuzima bw abaɲaɡihuɡu . naho ɾufise ibibazo vʲ imʲuzuɾe , isuɾi n imʲanda , ɾuʃoboɾa ɡusubiɾa kuba isoko ɾikomeje ɾʲ iteɾambeɾe ijo ɾutuŋanid͡ʒwe neza .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Naho hataboneka ikarata yemewe mpuzamakungu irugaragaza neza, Murago rufatwa nk’uruzi rwo mu rusobe rw’imigezi igaburira amazi mu nzuzi zikuru z’igihugu.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: naho hataboneka ikaɾata jemewe mpuzamakuŋu iɾuɡaɾaɡaza neza , muɾaɡo ɾufatwa nk uɾuzi ɾwo mu ɾusobe ɾw imiɡezi iɡabuɾiɾa amazi mu nzuzi zikuɾu z iɡihuɡu .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: ruva mu misozi miremire yo mu buseruko bwa Tanzania, aho amasoko y’amazi ava ku misozi ya Kilimanjaro na Meru ahurira agatanga uruzi runini. Uru ruzi rugenda rwerekeza mu buseruko, ruce mu bibaya, mu mirima n’amashyamba, mbere rugasozera urugendo rwarwo mu nyanja y’Indiyano hafi y’igisagara ca Pangani.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: ɾuva mu misozi miɾemiɾe jo mu buseɾuko bwa tanzania , aho amasoko j amazi ava ku misozi ja kilimand͡ʒaɾo na meɾu ahuɾiɾa aɡataŋa uɾuzi ɾunini . uɾu ɾuzi ɾuɡenda ɾweɾekeza mu buseɾuko , ɾut͡ʃe mu bibaja , mu miɾima n amaʃʲamba , mbeɾe ɾuɡasozeɾa uɾuɡendo ɾwaɾwo mu ɲand͡ʒa j indijano hafi j iɡisaɡaɾa t͡ʃa paŋani .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Mu nkengera za Awash haboneka ibinyabuzima vyinshi. Harimwo impala, gazelle, inguge, impyisi, intare, ingona n’amoko menshi y’inyoni.

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Rufasha mu kuhira imyaka, cane cane mu bice bifise imvura idahagije. Imirima ikikije uru ruzi ikura neza kubera amazi aboneka hafi.

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Uruzi rufasha mu kubungabunga ubuzima bw’ibinyabuzima bito bito vyo mu mazi n’inkengera zarwo, nk’amafi mato, udukoko tw’amazi n’ibimera vyo mu migezi.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: uɾuzi ɾufaʃa mu kubuŋabuŋa ubuzima bw ibiɲabuzima bito bito vʲo mu mazi n inkeŋeɾa zaɾwo , nk amafi mato , udukoko tw amazi n ibimeɾa vʲo mu miɡezi .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Ni uruzi rufise akamaro mu buzima bw’abantu, mu buhinzi, mu bidukikije, no mu gutanga amazi mu bice vyumye vya Afrika y’Ubuseruko.

Naho kitamenyekanye nk'ibindi biyaga vya Afurika y'Ubuseruko, gifise uruhara runini mu burovyi, ubuhinzi, ubworozi no kubungabunga ibinyabuzima. Kubera ko kitagira uruzi rusohokamwo, ubunini n'uburebure bw'amazi yaco burahindagurika bivanye n'imvura n'ihindagurika ry'ibihe.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: ni kimwe mu bijaɡa bihambaje vʲa tanzania . naho kitameɲekaɲe nk ibindi bijaɡa vʲa afuɾika j ubuseɾuko , ɡifise uɾuhaɾa ɾunini mu buɾovʲi , ubuhinzi , ubwoɾozi no kubuŋabuŋa ibiɲabuzima . kubeɾa ko kitaɡiɾa uɾuzi ɾusohokamwo , ubunini n ubuɾebuɾe bw amazi jat͡ʃo buɾahindaɡuɾika bivaɲe n imvuɾa n ihindaɡuɾika ɾʲ ibihe .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Igihe c'ici igihe bizwi ko haba ubushuhe cane kurusha ibindi bihe kuko nico gihe imvura itagwa canke ishobora kugwa 1 Mu Kwezi. N'igihe gikunda gutangura muri Ruheshi(6) kigahera muri myandagaro (8) aho ubushuhe bushobora gushika hagati ya 17°C na 29°C.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: iɡihe t͡ʃ it͡ʃi iɡihe bizwi ko haba ubuʃuhe t͡ʃane kuɾuʃa ibindi bihe kuko nit͡ʃo ɡihe imvuɾa itaɡwa t͡ʃanke iʃoboɾa kuɡwa ɾimwe mu kwezi . n iɡihe ɡikunda ɡutaŋuɾa muɾi ɾuheʃi ɡatandatu kiɡaheɾa muɾi mʲandaɡaɾo umunani aho ubuʃuhe buʃoboɾa ɡuʃika haɡati ja doɡeɾe it͡ʃumi na indwi na doɡeɾe miɾoŋo ibiɾi na it͡ʃenda .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Ariko muri ico gihe nyene, imvura iratangura, iboneka muburyo bwimvura y imiravyo myinshi, kandi buhoro buhoro iyo mvura iragabanya ubushuhe, bikagarura ibitigiri vyanditswe mugihe kiba gisigaye cumwaka, ni ukuvuga nka dogere 22/25 ku mutaga mu kiyaya, no hafi ya 27/28 ° C mu biyaya vyo mu burengero.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: aɾiko muɾi it͡ʃo ɡihe ɲene , imvuɾa iɾataŋuɾa , iboneka mubuɾʲo bwimvuɾa j imiɾavʲo mʲinʃi , kandi buhoɾo buhoɾo ijo mvuɾa iɾaɡabaɲa ubuʃuhe , bikaɡaɾuɾa ibitiɡiɾi vʲanditswe muɡihe kiba ɡisiɡaje t͡ʃumwaka , ni ukuvuɡa nka doɡeɾe miɾoŋo ibiɾi na kabiɾi na miɾoŋo ibiɾi na ɡatanu ku mutaɡa mu kijaja , no hafi ja miɾoŋo ibiɾi na indwi na miɾoŋo ibiɾi na umunani mu bijaja vʲo mu buɾeŋeɾo .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Umurwa mukuru, Bujumbura, uherereye ku nkombe z'ikiyaga. Aho hama hashushe umwaka wose, ariko ntibirenza urugero, kubera ko ubushuhe ntarengwa buri hagati ya dogere 29 hafi yumwaka wose, nubwo bugera kuri 30/31 ° C kuva hagati muri Myandagaro kugeza muri Gitugutu.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: umuɾwa mukuɾu , bud͡ʒumbuɾa , uheɾeɾeje ku nkombe z ikijaɡa . aho hama haʃuʃe umwaka wose , aɾiko ntibiɾenza uɾuɡeɾo , kubeɾa ko ubuʃuhe ntaɾeŋwa buɾi haɡati ja doɡeɾe miɾoŋo ibiɾi na it͡ʃenda hafi jumwaka wose , nubwo buɡeɾa kuɾi doɡeɾe miɾoŋo itatu na miɾoŋo itatu na ɾimwe kuva haɡati muɾi mʲandaɡaɾo kuɡeza muɾi ɡituɡutu .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Ikirere co muri ako karere kirashushe. Ubushuhe bwo mu mwaka muri y ni 17 °C . Ukwezi gushushe cane ni Nzero, aho ubushuhe bushika 20 °C, kandi igihe gikanye cane ni Mukakaro, kikaba gifise 16 °C .
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: ikiɾeɾe t͡ʃo muɾi ako kaɾeɾe kiɾaʃuʃe . ubuʃuhe bwo mu mwaka muɾi j ni doɡeɾe it͡ʃumi na indwi . ukwezi ɡuʃuʃe t͡ʃane ni nzeɾo , aho ubuʃuhe buʃika doɡeɾe miɾoŋo ibiɾi , kandi iɡihe ɡikaɲe t͡ʃane ni mukakaɾo , kikaba ɡifise doɡeɾe it͡ʃumi na ɡatandatu .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Ibi bikunda kubaho iyo indege iri kure Cane mukirere kuburebure burenga imetero 8000 (ni ukuvuga nka kilometero 8 uvuye hasi), ahaba hagera ubushuhe bwinshi (humidity) kandi hakaba hakonje cane (nko munsi ya -39°C). Ico gihe amazi aba asohotse mu mashini z’indege ahinduka urubura buhoro buhoro, bigatuma haboneka iyo mirongo yera.
ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: ibi bikunda kubaho ijo indeɡe iɾi kuɾe t͡ʃane mukiɾeɾe kubuɾebuɾe buɾeŋa imeteɾo ibihumbi munani ni ukuvuɡa nka kilometeɾo umunani uvuje hasi , ahaba haɡeɾa ubuʃuhe bwinʃi humiditʲ kandi hakaba hakond͡ʒe t͡ʃane nko munsi ja doɡeɾe miɾoŋo itatu na it͡ʃenda . it͡ʃo ɡihe amazi aba asohotse mu maʃini z indeɡe ahinduka uɾubuɾa buhoɾo buhoɾo , biɡatuma haboneka ijo miɾoŋo jeɾa .

Ikiyaga Tanganyika · Uruzi Ruvubu · Ikiy: Uruzi rwa Nasia ruherereye mu buraruko bwa Ghana hagati y’imirongo y’akarere iri hagati ya 9°55' na 10°40' mu buraruko hamwe na 1°05' mu burengero na 0°15' mu buseruko. ikijaɡa taŋaɲika uɾuzi ɾuvubu ikijaɡa ɾw: uɾuzi ɾwa nasia ɾuheɾeɾeje mu buɾaɾuko bwa ɡhana haɡati j imiɾoŋo j akaɾeɾe iɾi haɡati ja doɡeɾe it͡ʃenda miɾoŋo itanu na ɡatanu na doɡeɾe it͡ʃumi miɾoŋo ine mu buɾaɾuko hamwe na doɡeɾe ɾimwe ɡatanu mu buɾeŋeɾo na doɡeɾe zeɾu it͡ʃumi na ɡatanu mu buseɾuko . ɾukomoka ku ɡuhuɾiɾa hamwe kw utuɡezi tune dutoduto two mu misozi jo muɾi ako kaɾeɾe . iɲuma j aho , ɾutembeɾa ɾuɡana mu buɾeŋeɾo ɡuʃika aho ɾwind͡ʒiɾa muɾi white volta .
